description:
## Context
Issue #791: `packages/ticket-sync/lib/doctor.mjs:77` gates sidecar validation on `if (parsed)` after `JSON.parse`. When `.adlc/ticket-sync.state.json` contains a valid JSON falsy scalar (`null`, `0`, `false`, `""`), `JSON.parse` does not throw and `if (parsed)` is false, so all four sidecar checks are skipped and `doctor` exits 0 ("All checks passed").

## Normative Decisions
1. In `packages/ticket-sync/lib/doctor.mjs`, track `let parseOk = false` separately from the parsed value in the `JSON.parse` `try` block.
2. When `parseOk` is true, always validate `parsed` with `validateSyncState(parsed)` and record `sidecar-valid`; run the object-property checks (`sidecar-nodeid-unique`, `sidecar-syncedhash`, `sidecar-no-stale-pending`) only when `parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)`.
3. Add tests in `packages/ticket-sync/test/doctor.test.mjs` covering `null`, `false`, `0`, `""`, and `[]` sidecar files, proving `sidecar-valid` fails (`ok: false`, `exitCode: 2`) with `root: expected object`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `doctor` fails with `exitCode: 2` and `sidecar-valid` `ok: false` (`root: expected object`) when `.adlc/ticket-sync.state.json` contains `null`, `false`, `0`, `""`, or `[]` (`verify: node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/doctor.test.mjs`).
- AC2: Existing `doctor` checks on absent, unparseable, schema-invalid, and valid sidecars pass unchanged (`verify: node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/doctor.test.mjs`).
title: ticket-sync: fail sidecar-valid in doctor when sidecar parses to a falsy or non-object JSON value (#791)
